decisions.decision: The Board agreed by consensus, without a vote, to support restoring the Pavement Management Program as presented by the Town Manager.
decisions.quote: all the board members agreed that they are in support of restoring the pmp as presented by the town manager.

decisions.decision: Chair Nuzzolo asked that the Board formally vote at its next meeting not to put a municipal override forward as a Town Meeting warrant article. No vote was taken at this meeting.
decisions.quote: chair nuzzolo stated that he would like the board to formally vote at the next meeting not to have a municipal override as a town meeting warrant article.
